name: @mangos-ai/mcp

tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: List every Mangos AI agent with its platform, purpose, effective targeting and config revision. API keys are never returned. After choosing an agent, call inspect_agent_for_editing before changing it. Agents with setupStatus "draft" are still being created in the app: their configuration is incomplete, they never run, and every edit tool refuses them — do not pick one as the target of a change.

tools.name: create_agent
tools.description: Create a complete Mangos AI config for any user-facing social agent. Creation is config-only: the agent is visible and ready but paused, defaults to manual review, inherits the app AI settings, and does not log in, run, research, draft, publish, or send.

personaName.description: Founder, brand, or agent display name.

personaBio.description: At least 20 characters describing who the agent represents and its perspective.

productDesc.description: At least 20 characters describing the product, business, or subject.

generatedPersona.description: Optional complete voice profile. personaBio is used when omitted.

platformHandle.description: Account handle for the selected platform, without @, u/, or a profile URL. Facebook may omit it.

twitterHandle.description: Twitter/X handle. platformHandle is preferred for generic creation.

instagramHandle.description: Instagram handle. platformHandle is preferred for generic creation.

linkedinHandle.description: LinkedIn vanity slug. platformHandle is preferred for generic creation.

threadsHandle.description: Threads handle. platformHandle is preferred for generic creation.

redditUsername.description: Reddit username. platformHandle is preferred for generic creation.

facebookHandle.description: Optional Facebook Page or profile name.

topics.description: Subjects for original-post agents. Required for Twitter, LinkedIn, and Threads post agents.

searchTerms.description: Discovery phrases for reply, comment, and outreach agents.

communities.description: Subreddit names for Reddit or full Facebook Group URLs for Facebook.

threadUrls.description: Specific Reddit post URLs for Reddit DM prospect discovery.

hashtags.description: Single-word Instagram hashtags without #. At least three are required for Instagram commenting.

curatedProfiles.description: Instagram handles explicitly chosen for priority research. Never invent handles.

audience.description: At least 20 characters describing the ideal customer. Required for outreach agents.

productUrl.description: Public product URL. Required for outreach agents and optional for Reddit Post.

messageGoal.description: Low-pressure outreach call to action. Required for outreach agents.

tone.description: Writing, reply, comment, or DM tone in plain language.

goodExample.description: Optional example message whose style should be followed.

perCycle.description: Actions or prospects handled per run.

cadenceHours.description: Hours between scheduled runs. The new agent is still created paused.

approvalMode.description: Defaults to manual. Review-only platforms remain manual.

useGlobalSearch.description: Reddit Reply only. Allows creation without named communities.

discoverySources.description: LinkedIn outreach sources: topics, people, connections.

inspirationUrls.description: Reddit post URLs used as structural inspiration.

tools.name: create_instagram_dm_agent
tools.description: Create a paused, review-first Instagram DM outreach agent. It inherits the app's default AI provider and never sends or starts a schedule during creation. Supply the founder identity, Instagram handle, product, audience, message goal, and cold-discovery topic phrases. The agent prioritizes people recently engaged by the same Instagram account, then curated profiles, then topic discovery. Cold first messages cannot contain URLs, existing outbound conversations are blocked, and inbound-only conversations become reply drafts.

personaName.description: Founder, brand, or agent display name.

personaBio.description: At least 20 characters describing the founder or brand and its perspective.

instagramHandle.description: The sending Instagram account handle, without @. A profile URL is also accepted.

productDesc.description: At least 20 characters describing the product and who it helps.

productUrl.description: Public product website. https:// is added when omitted.

audience.description: At least 20 characters describing the ideal customer and useful fit signals.

messageGoal.description: What a DM should achieve, using a low-pressure next step.

searchTerms.description: Required human-readable topic phrases for cold prospect discovery, for example "founder led growth".

curatedProfiles.description: Optional Instagram handles the user explicitly wants prioritized, without @. Never invent handles.

tone.description: Optional DM tone. Defaults to warm and direct.

goodExample.description: Optional sample DM whose writing style should be followed.

dailyLimit.description: Optional daily send ceiling, 1 to 25. Defaults to 10.

perCycle.description: Optional prospects researched per run, 1 to 8. Defaults to 2.

cadenceHours.description: Optional hours between research runs, 0.25 to 168. Defaults to 4.

reviewDraftCap.description: Optional pending-review ceiling, 1 to 50. Defaults to 10.

minFitScore.description: Optional minimum prospect fit score, 0 to 100. Defaults to 55.

tools.name: create_email_campaign
tools.description: Create a paused organic email campaign configuration. Pass businessProfileId to use an existing Business Profile. If none exists, omit the id and supply businessProfile to create the profile and first campaign together. Creation never researches, imports prospects, drafts, schedules, or sends email.

businessProfileId.description: Optional existing email-outreach Business Profile id.

businessDescription.description: At least 20 characters describing the business and offer.

audience.description: At least 20 characters describing the ideal customer.

voiceProfile.description: Optional email-writing voice. The business description is used when omitted.

audience.description: At least 20 characters describing this campaign audience.

discoverySources.description: Any of google-local, product-hunt, hacker-news, github.

emailAccountId.description: Optional existing sending-account id. No account is required to create the paused config.

promptHint.description: What this sequence email should accomplish.

tools.name: list_email_accounts
tools.description: List sanitized SMTP and IMAP settings, connection health, and whether Mangos has a stored credential. Credentials are never returned.

tools.name: configure_email_account
tools.description: Update non-secret SMTP and IMAP settings for an existing Mangos email account. This tool never accepts passwords. Set reuseSmtpPasswordForImap to use the SMTP password already encrypted by Mangos. New credentials must be entered locally in the desktop app.

inboxUsername.description: Optional IMAP username. Blank uses the SMTP username.

inboxFolders.description: Optional receiving folders. An empty list monitors every safe receiving folder.

reuseSmtpPasswordForImap.description: Use the already encrypted SMTP password for IMAP.

physicalAddress.description: Optional valid postal address included in outgoing email footers.

tools.name: test_email_account
tools.description: Test an existing account using only credentials already encrypted in Mangos. No credential is returned or sent through MCP.

tools.name: sync_email_inbox
tools.description: Run an incremental IMAP sync now and apply reply, unsubscribe, bounce, suppression, and follow-up protections.

tools.name: disconnect_email_inbox
tools.description: Disconnect IMAP reply protection and erase any separately stored IMAP credential. Historical suppression and reply decisions remain enforced.

tools.name: push_email_list
tools.description: Push a structured people list into Mangos. Omit campaignId to create and activate a new list campaign from campaign; pass campaignId to append idempotently. Mangos validates, deduplicates across pushes and existing outreach, respects suppression and sent history, then researches accepted people at the saved cadence. This never approves or sends email.

campaignId.description: Optional existing list campaign id to append to.

audience.description: At least 20 characters describing this campaign audience.

discoverySources.description: Any of google-local, product-hunt, hacker-news, github.

emailAccountId.description: Optional existing sending-account id. No account is required to create the paused config.

promptHint.description: What this sequence email should accomplish.

intervalMinutes.description: Minutes between research batches, 5 to 1440. Defaults to 30.

batchSize.description: People researched per batch, 1 to 25. Defaults to 1.

windowStart.description: Research window start in local 24-hour HH:MM time. Defaults to 02:00.

windowEnd.description: Research window end in local 24-hour HH:MM time. Defaults to 07:00.

source.description: Source system, for example apollo, clay, airtable, or crm.

externalId.description: Stable person id from the source system. Used for idempotent re-pushes.

signals.description: Source facts or qualification signals Mangos may use during research.

location.description: Person or company location for timezone-aware scheduling.

tools.name: list_email_lists
tools.description: List every imported or MCP-pushed people list for one Business Profile, including processing funnel and campaign status.

tools.name: get_email_list
tools.description: Read a paginated Mangos people list with normalized source data, exclusions, research results, fit scores, and draft ids.

campaignId.description: List campaign id returned by push_email_list or list_email_lists.

cursor.description: Optional zero-based cursor returned by the previous page.

limit.description: Optional page size, 1 to 500. Defaults to 100.

statuses.description: Optional row statuses to include, for example pending, drafted, duplicate, suppressed, or failed.

tools.name: get_agent
tools.description: Full runtime detail for one agent: sanitized config, effective targeting, today's activity, recent actions, pending backlog, scheduled posts and outreach drafts. Use inspect_agent_for_editing before configuration changes.

agentId.description: Agent id, e.g. agent-1738... Get it from list_agents.

tools.name: get_agent_health
tools.description: Why an agent is or is not producing anything, over the last 7 days: run outcome counts, posts/replies/drafts produced, the consecutive empty-run streak (and how much the schedule has been slowed because of it), the dominant failure reason in plain language, and whether it needs a login. Use this before suggesting targeting changes.

agentId.description: Agent id, e.g. agent-1738... Get it from list_agents.

tools.name: inspect_agent_for_editing
tools.description: Required first step before editing an agent. Returns the full sanitized configuration, what this platform does, definitions for keywords and other fields, the targeting values actually used at runtime, semantic edit mappings, and a revision token that prevents stale overwrites.

agentId.description: Agent id, e.g. agent-1738... Get it from list_agents.

tools.name: update_agent_identity
tools.description: Edit who the agent represents and what it promotes. personaBio or productDesc changes regenerate the voice profile. platformHandle maps to the correct Twitter, Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, Threads, or Reddit handle field.

agentId.description: Agent id, e.g. agent-1738... Get it from list_agents.

expectedRevision.description: Exact revision returned by inspect_agent_for_editing. Re-inspect after any successful edit or stale revision error.

personaBio.description: Who the agent represents and their perspective.

productDesc.description: What the product or business does.

platformHandle.description: The account handle for this agent platform, without @ or u/.

tools.name: update_agent_targeting
tools.description: Platform-aware targeting edit. searchTerms automatically maps to the active topics, keywords, DM discovery terms, hashtags, or localSearchQueries field for this platform. Use effectiveBehavior in the response to verify what discovery will actually use. For Reddit, communities means subreddit names. For Facebook, communities means group URLs.

searchTerms.description: Primary platform search terms. Twitter DM uses tweet phrases, Instagram DM uses human-readable cold-discovery topic phrases, Reddit uses subreddit search phrases, and Instagram commenting uses single-word hashtags.

topics.description: Subjects for original posts. Not prospect-search terms.

messageGoal.description: What an outreach DM or email should achieve.

agentId.description: Agent id, e.g. agent-1738... Get it from list_agents.

expectedRevision.description: Exact revision returned by inspect_agent_for_editing. Re-inspect after any successful edit or stale revision error.

tools.description: Turn an agent's schedule on or off. Off means it stops running on its own; drafts already scheduled still post.

tools.name: run_agent
tools.description: Trigger one run of any configured agent, matching Run now in the app. Auto social agents may publish posts, replies, or comments immediately. Manual social agents create review drafts; outreach agents research prospects and queue drafts, without sending. Uses existing per-cycle settings and leaves schedules unchanged. Returns admission status (accepted, already_queued, already_running, or blocked), not completion. An accepted run may wait for the shared browser and remains subject to runtime limits and login requirements. Use get_agent to inspect activity and drafts afterward.

agentId.description: Agent id, e.g. agent-1738... Get it from list_agents.

tools.name: run_reddit_post_draft_cycle
tools.description: Run one Reddit Post research and draft-generation cycle now, then return any newly created drafts. This tool only accepts a Reddit Post agent. It does NOT approve, schedule, or publish anything. The run can still create no draft when research, subreddit rules, account access, or the review-draft cap blocks generation.

agentId.description: Agent id, e.g. agent-1738... Get it from list_agents.

tools.name: save_post_drafts

sourceRef.description: Optional source identifier, such as a commit hash or release tag.

tools.name: list_dm_drafts
tools.description: The DM outreach review queue for Twitter, Instagram, Reddit, and LinkedIn. Returns every draft plus open, pending, approved, inbound-reply, first-touch, and bulk-sendable counts. dailyByAgent reports sentToday, sendCap, and remainingSendsToday, including the account-scoped Instagram allowance. Instagram rows include actionType and relationshipState. Omit agentId for every DM agent at once.

agentId.description: Optional. Limit to one DM agent.

tools.name: update_dm_draft
tools.description: Rewrite one queued DM. Editing never sends it. If it was approved, the edit returns it to pending review so the changed text must be approved again.

agentId.description: Agent id, e.g. agent-1738... Get it from list_agents.

messageId.description: Message id, from the matching list_* tool.

tools.name: bulk_update_dm_drafts
tools.description: Rewrite many queued DMs in one call. Use this instead of calling update_dm_draft in a loop. Editing never sends anything, and changed approved drafts return to pending review. Returns which ids updated and which failed.

agentId.description: Agent id, e.g. agent-1738... Get it from list_agents.

edits.description: One entry per draft: { messageId, draft }.

messageId.description: Message id, from the matching list_* tool.

tools.name: approve_dm_drafts
tools.description: Mark DM drafts as approved, meaning the user has signed off and they are ready to send. THIS DOES NOT SEND THEM. Approving is safe and reversible with unapprove_dm_drafts. Approved drafts are the only ones send_dm_drafts can queue. Instagram inbound replies can be approved, but they remain explicit named sends and are never included in bulk Send approved. If a draft has a crossAgentWarning, tell the user another agent already messaged that person before approving it.

agentId.description: Agent id, e.g. agent-1738... Get it from list_agents.

items.description: Message id, from the matching list_* tool.

tools.name: unapprove_dm_drafts
tools.description: Take DM drafts back to pending review, so bulk send will no longer include them. Always safe.

agentId.description: Agent id, e.g. agent-1738... Get it from list_agents.

items.description: Message id, from the matching list_* tool.

tools.name: send_dm_drafts
tools.description: ACTUALLY SEND the named, approved DM drafts: real messages to real people, which cannot be recalled. Only call this when the user has explicitly asked to send. "Approve these" is NOT a request to send. Confirm first, naming every recipient. Exact messageIds are required and pending drafts are refused. Instagram inbound replies are supported only through this explicit named-send path. The app rechecks the live conversation, applies daily caps, and sends one at a time with human-like pauses.

agentId.description: Agent id, e.g. agent-1738... Get it from list_agents.

items.description: Message id, from the matching list_* tool.

messageIds.description: The exact draft ids to send.

messageId.description: Message id, from the matching list_* tool.

agentId.description: Optional. Limit to one email agent.

tools.description: Rewrite many queued emails in one call. Use this instead of calling update_email_draft in a loop. Editing does not approve or send anything. Returns which ids updated and which failed.

agentId.description: Agent id, e.g. agent-1738... Get it from list_agents.

edits.description: One entry per draft: { messageId, subject?, bodyText? }.

messageId.description: Email message id (a uuid string), from list_email_drafts.

tools.description: Mark email drafts as approved, meaning the user has signed off and they are ready to send. THIS DOES NOT SEND THEM. Approving is safe and reversible with unapprove_email_drafts, and it never sets a send time. Approved drafts are the only ones the app's "Send approved" button will send, and the only ones send_email_drafts can queue. Already-scheduled drafts are skipped; they have their own committed send time.

agentId.description: Agent id, e.g. agent-1738... Get it from list_agents.

tools.name: unapprove_email_drafts

items.description: Email message id (a uuid string), from list_email_drafts.

tools.name: send_email_drafts
tools.description: ACTUALLY SEND the named email drafts: real email to real people, which cannot be recalled. Only call this when the user has explicitly asked to send; "approve these" is NOT a request to send. Confirm with the user first, naming who will receive them. You must list the exact messageIds; there is no send-everything option. The app sends them one at a time with pauses, from the user's connected mailbox, and stops at their send allowance.

messageIds.description: The exact draft ids to send.

instructions: Mangos AI manages local social and outreach agents. Always call inspect_agent_for_editing before changing agent configuration, use semantic edit tools, pass expectedRevision, and verify effectiveBehavior. Approval never authorizes sending.
